text:
Sam Torres: FYI spotted duplicate active sessions and duplicate quota hits when clients reconnect across edges during proxy half-close. Happens on canary.
Yara Ahmed: Repro steps?
Sam Torres: Open SSE/WS, inject FIN on proxy (netem delay), client reconnects to other edge -> new accept; old shard never GCed. Minimal log:
```
INFO accept resume_id=rz_55 shard=eu-1 last_event=88
INFO accept resume_id=rz_55 shard=eu-2 last_event=88
```
Ben Cho: Sounds like claim race. Backend fix: keep optimistic accept but spawn async reconciler that does CAS on routing-metadata and emits a quota_compensation event if lost.
Yara Ahmed: Console mitigation in the meantime? We get paged on quota alerts.
Sam Torres: Add transient dedupe in aggregation: treat (tenant,resume_id) as one active session for 60s, mark as "reconciling" in UI. Non-destructive.
Ben Cho: Also add metric `stream_resume_conflict` with tags shard/tenant/route and log claim_nonce on accept so we can correlate winners.
infra-bot: Note: lowering tombstone TTL reduces window but risks false evictions under flakey clients.
ops-bot: Created INF-9100: "streaming: async reconcile + console dedupe (60s)" assigned to Yara. ETA 3d.
deploy-bot: Rolling patch: async-reconciler worker -> canary eu-1 in 25m.
Yara Ahmed: Action items: 1) PR for reconciler (Ben) 2) claim_nonce logs + metric (Ben/Sam) 3) console dedupe flag (Yara) 4) watch stream_resume_conflict on canary (ops).
Sam Torres: I'll add an admin-evict endpoint draft for emergencies: `POST /admin/resume/{id}/evict?force=true` w/ dry_run option.
Ben Cho: Will include compensating event payload shape for billing: {tenant_id,resume_id,delta_ts,reason:"duplicate_claim"}.
Yara Ahmed: Good. Keep the UI mute by default and surface raw numbers in advanced view.
Sam Torres: Thanks all — will post canary metrics after deploy. :thumbsup:
